name: Wake and Tremble
text:
Trigger You Rouse the World.

---
You have the world wake with a great convulsion. All other creatures in the area when you Rouse the World must attempt a Reflex save save against your world rouser DC.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature falls and lands Prone.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature also becomes Sickened 1.
